title: n8n
comment: n8n keeps everything in one .n8n directory (database.sqlite, encryptionKey, workflow data); the official image uses /home/node/.n8n and the Daemonless image reads the same tree from /config. The encryption key must carry or every stored credential is lost -- it lives in the directory, so one carry covers it. Webhook URLs referencing the old host carry as data and need editing. There is no FreeBSD package; only a Linux source applies.
